content: पत् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (पतति, पतित) .²1 To fall, fall down, come down, descend, drop down, alight; अवाङ्मुखस्योपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात विद्याधरहस्तमुक्ता <ls>R. 2. 60</ls>; वृष्टिर्भवने चास्य पेतुषी <ls n="R.">10. 77</ls>; (रेणुः) पतति परिणतारुणप्रकाशः शलभसमूह इवाश्रमद्रुमेषु <ls>Ś. 1. 31</ls>; <ls>Me. 107</ls>; <ls>Bk. 7. 9</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">21. 6</ls>. .²2 To fly, move through the air, soar; हन्तुं कलहकारोऽसौ शब्दकारः पपात खम् <ls>Bk. 5. 100</ls>; see पतत् below. .²3 To set, sink (below the horizon); सोऽयं सोमः पतति गगनादल्पशेषमैर्यूखैः <ls>Ś. 4. 2</ls> <ab>v. l.</ab>; पतत्पतङ्गप्रतिमस्तपोनिधिः <ls>Śi. 1. 12</ls>. .²4 To cast oneself at, throw oneself down, मयि ते पादपतिते किंकरत्वमुपागते <ls>Pt. 4. 7</ls>; so चरणपतितम् <ls>Me. 105</ls>; .²5 To fall (in a moral sense), lose oneʼs caste, forfeit oneʼs rank or position, fall off; परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः <ls>Ms. 10. 97</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 16</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 19</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 200</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 38</ls>. .²6 To come down (as from heaven); पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः <ls>Bg. 1. 42</ls>. .²7 To fall, be reduced to wretchedness or misery; प्रायः कन्दुकपातेनोत्पतत्यार्यः पतन्नपि <ls>Bh. 2. 123</ls>. .²8 To go down into hell, go to perdition; <ls>Ms. 11. 37</ls>; प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ <ls>Bg. 16. 16</ls>. .²9 To fall, occur, come to pass, take place; लक्ष्मीर्यत्र पतन्ति तत्र विवृतद्वारा इव व्यापदः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²10 To be directed to, light or fall upon (with <ab>loc.</ab>); प्रसादसौम्यानि सतां सुहृज्जने पतन्ति चक्षूंषि न दारुणाः शराः <ls>Ś. 6. 29</ls>. .²11 To fall to oneʼs lot or share. .²12 To be in, fall in or into. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (पातयति-ते, पतयति rarely) .²1 To cause to fall down, descend or sink <ab>&c.</ab>; निपतन्ती पतिमप्यपातयत् <ls>R. 8. 38</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 76</ls>. .²2 To let fall, throw or drop down, fell down (as trees <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 To ruin, overthrow; व्यपदेशमाविलयितुं किमीहसे जनमिमं च पातयितुम् <ls>Ś. 5. 21</ls>. .²4 To shed (as tears). .²5 To cast, direct (as the sight). .²6 To dash or strike out. .²7 To throw or put in, cause to enter. .²8 To bring to ruin or misfortune. .²9 To depreciate, lower the value of anything; अर्घतः पातिताः <ls>Bh. 2. 15</ls>. .²10 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) To subtract, deduct. .²11 To set in motion, set on foot. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (पिपतिषति|पित्सति) To wish to fall. --II. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पत्यते) <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 To be master of. .²2 To rule, control. .²3 To possess. .²4 To be fit for, serve for (with <ab>dat.</ab>). --III. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (पतयति-ते) .²1 To go, move. .²2 To be master of (intransitive).
